picks.catalyst: Gap up: earnings beat + raised full-year guidance

picks.catalyst: Gap up: earnings beat, best comps in 5 years, raised guidance
picks.why: Best Buy beat on profit ($1.62 vs $1.49) and sales ($10.24B vs $9.91B), had its best same-store sales growth in five years (+6.1%) and raised its full-year targets, and headlines say the stock is surging pre-market; strong news, but I couldn't find a reliable pre-market % or price, so check the live quote first.

picks.catalyst: Gap down: record year but next-quarter guidance a bit below estimates
picks.why: Analog Devices posted record results ($4.37B quarterly revenue, full year up 38%) but guided next quarter's profit to $3.82 vs about $3.89 expected, so it's down about 8% in a weak chip market; this is a sell-the-news hit to sentiment, not to the business, so it can bounce if sellers dry up early.

picks.catalyst: Gap down: pullback after Monday's 31% jump on Jensen Huang's return as CEO
picks.why: Nvidia soared 31% Monday when Jensen Huang was reinstated as CEO and is giving back about 5% today as chip stocks and Nasdaq futures (-1.7%) slide; there's no bad company news, so it's a profit-taking dip in a very liquid name, but the market is shaky, so respect the stop.
